note: ao-plan-*.webp covers world x in [x0,x0+size], z in [z0,z0+size] metres. Sample u=(x-x0)/size, v=(z-z0)/size with texture.flipY=false (image row 0 = z0). White=unoccluded, darker=occluded; use as multiply (aoMap with uv remap, a planar-projected overlay, or onBeforeCompile).
